artifacts.name: base-x86
artifacts.notes: x86 Bliss OS base set (base_x86.qcow2/.kernel/.initrd.img + data-template + devkit). Carries libndk_translation so the arm-only arceus APK runs. The bootable x86 arceus offset is NOT yet baked — see the Slice C plan.

artifacts.name: omnidroid-bundle
artifacts.notes: Handoff only (not in the stable manifest; fetch by name). omnidroid working tree with WIP: recovered X86_* constants, the OMNIDROID_CONFIG_PATH fix, and bundled Windows QEMU (qemu/*.exe) + prebuilt dist/omnidroid.exe. This is the omnidroid state the Windows session needs (origin/main lacks the WIP).

artifacts.notes: Handoff only (fetch by name). The retargeted arm64 arceus build to bake onto the x86 base as base_x86_data_offset_arceusremote.qcow2.
